### Load libs and data

Boxplots of estimated NB overdispersion (`NB_theta`) and baseline expression (`G`) for each sheet of Dataset S1.

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

xlsx_path = "~/Downloads/Dataset_S1.xlsx"
sheets = excel_sheets(xlsx_path)
sheets

S1 = lapply(sheets, function(s) read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = s))
names(S1) = sheets

jitter_width <- 0.15
jitter_seed <- 123 # A specific seed for reproducibility

#Range of NB_theta used in the realistic and idealized simulations (theta_range = c(0.1, 1.2))
sim_theta_range = c(0.1, 1.2)
sim_G_range = c(0.1, 5)
```

### Plotting function

Same format as the phi boxplots in AD_cells.qmd. A Wilcoxon significance bar (same star cutoffs as stat_compare_means) is drawn only when there are exactly two groups. With `y_max`, the y-axis is cut at that value: the boxes still use every gene, and points above the cut are drawn at the limit as triangles.

```{r}
plot_parameter_box = function(d, group_col, fill_values, title, x_lab, x_labels = waiver(),
                              y_max = NULL, y_min = NULL, value_col = "NB_theta",
                              y_lab = "NB overdispersion (theta)", value_name = "theta") {
  d = d %>% mutate(group = factor(.data[[group_col]]), value = .data[[value_col]])
  #A single unnamed color is used for every group
  if (is.null(names(fill_values)) && length(fill_values) == 1) {
    fill_values = setNames(rep(fill_values, nlevels(d$group)), levels(d$group))
  }
  #Points above y_max are drawn at y_max
  if (is.null(y_max)) y_max = max(d$value, na.rm = TRUE)
  d = d %>% mutate(above_cap = value > y_max, value_plot = pmin(value, y_max))
  if (is.null(y_min)) y_min = min(d$value, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_pad = 0.05 * (y_max - y_min)

  median_df = d %>%
    dplyr::group_by(group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(median_value = median(value, na.rm = TRUE))

  p = ggplot(d, aes(x = group, y = value, fill = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(x = group, y = value_plot, shape = above_cap),
      alpha = 0.4,
      position = position_jitter(width = jitter_width, seed = jitter_seed)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_values) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 16, "TRUE" = 17)) +
    geom_label(
      data = median_df,
      aes(x = group, y = median_value, label = round(median_value, 2)),
      vjust = -0.3, # Just above the median line, so labels stay on their own box with several groups
      fill = "white",
      alpha = 0.8,
      label.size = 0,
      label.padding = unit(0.1, "lines"),
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 3) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      y = y_lab,
      x = x_lab
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none", # The x-axis labels are sufficient
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1), # Angle labels
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase y-axis text size
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase x-axis title size
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase y-axis title size
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),   # Increase legend title size
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    #coord_cartesian zooms without dropping genes from the box statistics
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min, y_max + 3 * y_pad)) # Room above y_max for the significance bar

  n_above = sum(d$above_cap, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (n_above > 0) {
    p = p + labs(caption = paste0("Triangles: ", n_above, ifelse(n_above == 1, " gene", " genes"),
                                  " with ", value_name, " > ", y_max, ", drawn at the limit"))
  }

  if (nlevels(d$group) == 2) {
    #Significance bar drawn by hand. stat_compare_means() offsets the bar by a fraction of the
    #full data range (including genes above y_max), which pushes it out of the zoomed plot.
    #The test uses every gene, not the capped values.
    groups = levels(d$group)
    p_val = wilcox.test(d$value[d$group == groups[1]], d$value[d$group == groups[2]])$p.value
    p_signif = as.character(symnum(p_val, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE,
                                   cutpoints = c(0, 1e-04, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
                                   symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns")))
    y_bar = y_max + y_pad
    tip = 0.02 * (y_bar - y_min) # Length of the small vertical lines
    p = p +
      annotate("segment", x = c(1, 1, 2), xend = c(1, 2, 2),
               y = c(y_bar - tip, y_bar, y_bar), yend = c(y_bar, y_bar, y_bar - tip)) +
      annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_bar, label = p_signif, vjust = -0.3, size = 5)
  }
  p
}

add_sim_range = function(p, sim_range, subtitle) {
  background = list(
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = sim_range[1], ymax = sim_range[2],
             fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.2),
    geom_hline(yintercept = sim_range, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40")
  )
  p$layers = c(background, p$layers)
  p + labs(subtitle = subtitle)
}
```

Same plot with the simulated range of NB_theta shaded. The subtitle gives the percent of genes inside that range.

```{r}
pct_in_sim_range = S1[[4]] %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(pct = round(100 * mean(NB_theta >= sim_theta_range[1] & NB_theta <= sim_theta_range[2], na.rm = TRUE)))
pct_in_sim_range

theta_AD_sim_range = add_sim_range(
  theta_AD, sim_theta_range,
  paste0("Shaded: simulated theta (", sim_theta_range[1], "-", sim_theta_range[2], ")\n",
         "CTL ", pct_in_sim_range$pct[pct_in_sim_range$condition == 0], "%, ",
         "AD ", pct_in_sim_range$pct[pct_in_sim_range$condition == 1], "% of genes inside")
)
theta_AD_sim_range
ggsave("~/Desktop/NB_theta_boxplot_AD_CTL_sim_range.pdf", theta_AD_sim_range, device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 5)
```

### Baseline expression (G) with the simulated range

The shaded band covers the simulated range of 0.1 to 5. The subtitle gives the percentage of genes in that range for each group. Triangles at 10 represent higher values. The boxplots, median labels, and Wilcoxon test use the original values.

```{r}
plot_G_box = function(d, group_col, fill_values, title, x_lab, x_labels = waiver()) {
  p = plot_parameter_box(d, group_col, fill_values, title, x_lab, x_labels = x_labels,
                         y_max = 10, y_min = 0, value_col = "G", y_lab = "Baseline expression (G)",
                         value_name = "G") +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 2.5))
  pct_by_group = d %>%
    group_by(group = factor(.data[[group_col]])) %>%
    summarise(pct = round(100 * mean(between(G, sim_G_range[1], sim_G_range[2]), na.rm = TRUE)),
              .groups = "drop")
  group_names = as.character(pct_by_group$group)
  if (!inherits(x_labels, "waiver")) group_names = unname(x_labels[group_names])
  pct_labels = paste(group_names, paste0(pct_by_group$pct, "%"))
  pct_lines = vapply(split(pct_labels, ceiling(seq_along(pct_labels) / 2)), paste,
                     character(1), collapse = ", ")
  subtitle = paste0("Genes in the shaded range (G = ", paste(sim_G_range, collapse = "-"), ")\n",
                    paste(pct_lines, collapse = "\n"))
  add_sim_range(p, sim_G_range, subtitle)
}

G_scn = plot_G_box(S1[[1]] %>% mutate(all_cells = "SCN"), "all_cells",
                   fill_values = rgb(146, 203, 193, maxColorValue = 255),
                   title = "Mouse SCN", x_lab = "Cell type")
G_hep_combined = plot_G_box(S1[[2]], "cell_type", fill_values = rgb(183, 226, 94, maxColorValue = 255),
                            title = "Mouse hepatocytes (combined)", x_lab = "Cell type")
G_hep_separate = plot_G_box(S1[[3]], "cell_type", fill_values = custom_colors,
                            title = "Mouse hepatocytes (separate)", x_lab = "Cell type")
G_AD = plot_G_box(S1[[4]], "condition", fill_values = color_palette,
                  title = "Human excitatory neurons", x_lab = "Condition",
                  x_labels = c("0" = "CTL", "1" = "AD"))

G_scn
G_hep_combined
G_hep_separate
G_AD

ggsave("~/Desktop/G_boxplot_mouse_SCN_sim_range.pdf", G_scn, width = 5, height = 5)
ggsave("~/Desktop/G_boxplot_hepatocytes_combined_sim_range.pdf", G_hep_combined, width = 5, height = 5)
ggsave("~/Desktop/G_boxplot_hepatocytes_separate_sim_range.pdf", G_hep_separate, width = 6, height = 5)
ggsave("~/Desktop/G_boxplot_AD_CTL_sim_range.pdf", G_AD, width = 5, height = 5)
```

### Phase dispersion by NB overdispersion, relative bulk amplitude, and baseline expression

Each point is a gene estimate from Dataset S1. Panels follow the workbook's sheet order. Phase dispersion is shown in hours. Relative bulk amplitude is the 24 h bulk amplitude divided by the bulk mesor for rows with a finite, positive mesor. The theta and `G` axes use pseudo-log scales to show the spread near zero and the upper tails.

```{r}
S1_phi <- bind_rows(S1, .id = "dataset") %>%
  mutate(
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = names(S1)),
    relative_bulk_amplitude = `24hr_amp_bulk` / if_else(is.finite(mesor_bulk) & mesor_bulk > 0,
                                                        mesor_bulk, NA_real_)
  )

plot_phi_scatter <- function(d, x_col, phi_col, x_lab) {
  d %>%
    mutate(phi_hours = .data[[phi_col]] * 12 / pi) %>%
    filter(is.finite(phi_hours), is.finite(.data[[x_col]])) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = phi_hours)) +
    geom_point(color = "#21657D", alpha = 0.5, size = 1.4) +
    expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = "Estimated phase dispersion (h)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))
}

phi_vs_theta <- plot_phi_scatter(S1_phi, "NB_theta", "phi_phase_dispersion", "NB overdispersion (theta)") +
  facet_wrap(vars(dataset), ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(transform = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 0.1),
                     breaks = c(-1, -0.25, 0, 0.25, 1, 5)) +
  labs(caption = "Theta is displayed on a pseudo-log scale.")

phi_vs_relative_amp <- plot_phi_scatter(S1_phi, "relative_bulk_amplitude", "phi_phase_dispersion",
                                        "Relative bulk amplitude (24 h amplitude / mesor)") +
  facet_wrap(vars(dataset), ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(0.25), labels = scales::label_percent(),
                     expand = expansion(mult = 0.07))

phi_vs_G <- plot_phi_scatter(S1_phi, "G", "phi_phase_dispersion", "Baseline expression (G)") +
  facet_wrap(vars(dataset), ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(transform = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 0.1),
                     breaks = c(0.1, 0.5, 2, 5, 20, 50)) +
  labs(caption = "G is displayed on a pseudo-log scale.")

phi_vs_theta
phi_vs_relative_amp
phi_vs_G

ggsave("~/Desktop/phi_vs_NB_theta.pdf", phi_vs_theta, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("~/Desktop/phi_vs_relative_bulk_amplitude.pdf", phi_vs_relative_amp, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("~/Desktop/phi_vs_G.pdf", phi_vs_G, width = 8, height = 6)
```
